title: Sync line, off (phone)
caption: The save strip gains one line: Sync and a switch, off. Nothing else on the page changes while it is off.

title: Sync line, off (desktop)
caption: The same line on a wide screen, under Export and Import.

title: Turn on sync
caption: Flipping the switch opens a panel below the strip: make a new sync code or use one you have, or cancel.

title: Your sync code
caption: A new code, shown once, wrapping only between groups; you type its last group back before sync starts.

title: Joining with a typo
caption: A mistyped code is caught on the device before anything is sent; Join stays off.
